description: This file is a C source file implementing Windows ANSI console handling for Git, including console detection, ANSI escape code processing, and pipe management.

methods.name: warn_if_raster_font
methods.description: Checks if the console font supports Unicode and warns if not.

methods.name: is_console
methods.description: Determines if a file descriptor is attached to a console.

methods.name: write_console
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 to UTF-16 and writes to the console.

methods.name: set_console_attr
methods.description: Sets console text attributes based on current style.

methods.name: erase_in_line
methods.description: Clears the current line in the console.

methods.name: set_attr
methods.description: Parses ANSI escape codes and updates console attributes.

methods.name: console_thread
methods.description: Thread function that reads from pipe and processes ANSI codes.

methods.name: winansi_exit
methods.description: Cleans up console resources on exit.

methods.name: winansi_dup2
methods.description: Duplicates file descriptors, updating console handle cache.

methods.name: swap_osfhnd
methods.description: Replaces a file descriptor's handle with a new one.

methods.name: winansi_isatty
methods.description: Checks if a file descriptor is interactive, with internal caching.

methods.name: winansi_init
methods.description: Initializes console handling, sets up pipes and threads.

methods.name: winansi_get_osfhandle
methods.description: Returns the real OS handle for stdout/stderr if redirected.
